properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 1). Every entry of upstream_status `members` carries `reviewed_revision` (the pin's `version`: the source revision the hub last reviewed the member at) and `record_state` (the kind of that pin's watch finding: unchanged, moved, never_seen, missing, unreadable, unreachable, refused, graph_id_mismatch, not_observed, or not_watched). reflow2 does no git I/O: the hub's own tooling fetches and re-declares the pin with the new version, which re-takes the record's baseline; the hub skill says how. Core: depends.rs MemberRelation and reconcile_upstream.
properties.name: upstream_status shows each member's reviewed source revision beside the state of its design record
